category_title: Typically developing students without identified behavior problems
minimal_context: The student is sitting in an academic classroom listening to the teacher present new material.
dialogue:
TUTOR: I am going to present the new material for today's lesson. Please just sit quietly and observe while I go through these slides.

STUDENT: (Sits quietly, passively attending to the instruction by tracking the teacher with their eyes, as they are not required to do anything other than listen.)

TUTOR: Let me pause here for a few minutes to find the next file on my computer.

STUDENT: (Raises a hand to get the teacher's attention during the pause.)

TUTOR: (Continues looking at the computer screen) Just hold on.

STUDENT: (Drops hand after not being acknowledged. Looks away from the front of the room and begins texting on a phone, engaging in an off-task activity incompatible with any assigned task since it is down time and no expectations are apparent.)

options.A: Incorporating relationship-building components like a pleasant voice tone, neutral facial expressions, and relaxed body posture.
options.B: Using psychometric assessments to set individual targets and providing frequent acknowledgment of achievements.
options.C: Requesting that all student questions be held until the end of the lesson.
options.D: Increasing the time spent teaching as opposed to not teaching during the lesson.
